propositions: Mirror Guard workflow exits 1 on a single instantaneous sample of expected self-healing Gerrit-to-GitHub replication lag instead of re-sampling within a sustained-divergence evaluation window

The module's design docstring (d96628c9dca) delegates transient-lag absorption to the alarm layer's sustained-divergence window, implemented in the secondary CloudWatch watcher but never wired into the primary workflow

The fix adds an in-process, portable persistence wrapper that re-samples up to 3 times with 45-second spacing (~90s window) and fails only when divergence persists, converging samples immediately return healthy
GitHub-ahead or foreign divergence (true invariant breach) never converges and remains loudly failed; missing SHA on first sample returns unhealthy immediately without re-sampling
Workflow header comment is updated to document the new sustained-divergence semantics; replication_verdict() remains unchanged and reports instantaneous truth
